versions.name: Citizenship in the Community
versions.description: Map the services and landmarks where you live, sit in on a council or school board meeting, interview the official responsible for an issue you care about, and find how local charities put volunteers to work.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
